title: RA$^2$: Retain-Anchored Attraction Preserves Forget-Adjacent Utility in LLM Unlearning
abstract: arXiv:2610.19385v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) unlearning is often evaluated primarily by target suppression and clean retain utility. These metrics can miss a local failure mode: a model may perform well on standard retain prompts, yet degrade on benign reasoning when prompts lie near the forgotten domain. This phenomenon is termed forget-adjacent utility loss. A fundamental question is: where should forget representations go after they leave the removed behavior? Successful unlearning depends not only on whether forget-conditioned representations depart from the harmful computation, but also on the direction in which they are redirected afterward. We propose RA$^2$ (Retain-Anchored Attraction), a latent-space unlearning method that redirects forget-token states toward nearby retain-supported representations while preserving higher-layer behavior on retain data. On WMDP and MUSE, RA$^2$ yields higher forget-adjacent utility than strong unlearning baselines

translated_title: RA$^2$：基于保留锚定吸引的机器遗忘方法保持遗忘邻接效用
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）遗忘的评估通常主要依赖目标抑制能力和干净保留数据上的效用。这些指标可能漏掉一种局部失败模式：模型在标准保留提示上可能表现良好，但当提示位于被遗忘领域附近时，其良性推理能力会下降，这种现象被称为遗忘邻接效用损失。一个根本性的问题是：遗忘表示在脱离被移除的行为之后应该去向何处？成功的遗忘不仅取决于遗忘条件下的表示是否离开了有害计算，还取决于它们随后被重定向的方向。我们提出RA$^2$（保留锚定吸引），这是一种潜空间遗忘方法，它将遗忘词元状态重定向到附近由保留数据支持的表示，同时保持保留数据上的高层行为。在WMDP和MUSE基准上，RA$^2$获得了比强遗忘基线更高的遗忘邻接效用。
tldr: 提出RA$^2$（保留锚定吸引）潜空间遗忘方法，通过将遗忘词元表示重定向至附近由保留数据支持的表示，在有效遗忘的同时保持被遗忘领域附近提示的良性推理效用。
en_tdlr: RA$^2$ (Retain-Anchored Attraction) redirects forget-token representations toward nearby retain-supported representations in latent space, achieving effective unlearning while preserving utility on benign prompts near the forgotten domain.
